numbers.name: o2_identity
numbers.value: implemented N^mu equals the sympy current and d_mu N^mu = chi_1 E_2 - chi_2 E_1 with the portal on, 20 random off-shell points in flat 3+1 (rel < 1e-10)

numbers.name: diffeomorphism_identity
numbers.value: N dE_N/dt = sum_q E_q dq/dt in a Bianchi I universe with all Theory Card terms, 20 random off-shell points (rel < 1e-10); fails when a term breaks time reparametrization

numbers.name: generalized_bianchi_general_metric
numbers.value: inhomogeneous non-diagonal metric (N, g_tx, a, b, c, phi, chi functions of t and x): implemented metric residual equals the Theory Card form, and nabla^mu E_mu_nu = -kappa (E_phi d_nu phi + sum_A E_A d_nu chi_A) with the implemented residuals at 20 random off-shell points (rel < 1e-10); fails when the portal is left out of the stress

numbers.name: generalized_bianchi_full_metric
numbers.value: full metric with all ten components nonzero polynomials in t, x, y, z (every off-diagonal entry on), fields depending on all four coordinates: the identity holds for the implemented residuals at 20 random off-shell points (4 draws x 5 points, rel < 1e-10), every component nu = t, x, y, z off shell; the numeric mpmath geometry used here matches the sympy route (R, G_mu_nu, box phi; rel < 1e-10) on a block metric; fails when the portal is left out of the stress

numbers.name: poincare_charges_lattice

numbers.name: boost_negative_control

numbers.name: angular_momentum_lattice
numbers.value: 2+1 lattice: drifts of L = int (x P_y - y P_x) over t = 4 are 5.1e-3, 1.3e-3, 3.3e-4 at n = 128, 256, 512 (orders 1.96, 1.99), with E, P_x, P_y also at order 1.95-1.99 and the O(2) charge conserved to 2e-15

note: Derivation and numerical check only; no external data. Noether's first theorem: the internal O(2) charge (chi number) is conserved although matter trades energy with the response field through the portal, because the portal depends only on |chi|^2. Second theorem: diffeomorphism invariance of the full action with gravity keeps the Hamiltonian constraint, so total energy of matter, phi and geometry is conserved while matter energy alone is not (C_EXCHANGE_DERIVED). Translations and boosts in flat space: energy, momentum and the boost charge are conserved, the last only because phi and chi share one light cone. Rotations: angular momentum is conserved on a 2+1 lattice. The diffeomorphism identity is checked in Bianchi I with gravity and, as the full generalized Bianchi identity, on an inhomogeneous non-diagonal metric depending on t and x and on a full metric whose ten components all depend on t, x, y, z. Nearest known theory: Noether 1918, ADM constraint, Poincare charges of scalar fields. Not UET-distinct.
